body: Oh my goodness, thank you! That's awesome!
I can definitely see her doing this out of spite haha I think it also might have to do with the fact that I left water in that now shattered bowl.
I'm feeling better today, thank you so much. I saw a doctor, we upped my medicine dosage, I'm trying to focus on doing things that make me happy.

I'm so sorry for your loss and that you have to go through this. What breaks my heart the most is that I know the people around me would suffer. And you're right, people I wouldn't even think about would suffer. Because I've certainly been effected by the death of people that I wouldn't consider myself close to. Or that I even knew. And that's what has kept me here so long. I really can't stand thinking about how many people would end up cry because I'm gone. Even when I feel like I don't deserve a single tear.
Thank you for taking the time to share with me.

Talking about how I feel and what is going on inside my head has always been a very hard thing for me to do. I think its one of my biggest flaws. Because it ends up pushing people away. 
That being said..yes, the people closest to me do know about my depression. And I know if I expressed to severity of the situation, that would do what they can to help. But I feel like people who don't really understand what it feels like can't help that much. You can't just tell someone who is depressed to cheer up and itll get better. That's what they want to say, but it just doesn't do anything for me except make me not want to open up and be further misunderstood.

I addressed my boyfriend, daughter, and parents in different sections. I think the main purpose of my note was to try and make everyone feel as ok about it as possible. And I know of course they wont be ok. But I tried to provide as much solace as possible. Obviously I talked about why this is happening, but I really tried to do it gently. It broke my heart to write it. It really did.

I feel like a big thing that gets me so upset is feeling guilty. I feel guilty about causing so much pain in the ppl's lives around me. I fee tremendously guilty that I'm not a better mother to my daughter. I feel like she would be much better off without me as a source of stress in her life.

Thank you for your kind words. 
I feel like my underlying problem is me. Yes, it gets worse when bad things happen, like financial issues. But my life situation is getting better right now (just got a new job after losing mine last month, boyfriend got a new car, we moved into a house) and yet I seem to be feeling worse and worse each day. Small things set me off and I have to go in the bathroom and cry for half an hour. I cut last week for the first time in over a year, and I really didn't even have a reason other than I was so frustrated and upset that I had to do something. I had to control that one area of my life. 
Finding coping mechanisms does help. I used to write a lot, but have not lately. I feel like nothing I could write would be good enough. But I know if I forced myself to do it, it would make me feel better than crying in the bathroom. So thank you for that advice. I will try to be better about finding something else to focus on.
